title: A Decisão
summary: At 19:30 on 2026-11-07, the 143-person vote approves the food-service policy and selects three chains for invitations and negotiations only.
keyEvents: The proposal receives 126 yes votes and 17 no votes.
In-N-Out Burger, Chipotle Mexican Grill, and Chick-fil-A receive the highest preferences.
Adrian authorizes invitations and negotiations, not partnerships or contracts.
The result is presented at 19:30 on Saturday, 2026-11-07.
Aphromoo stands beside Thinkcard, and 404 speaks with Moss.
League and Counter-Strike personnel interact as one organization.
consequences: The selected chains may be invited to negotiate under Kairos's restrictions.
No partnership, opening, construction, or contract is confirmed.
